India and China Hold Trade Talks on Imbalance and Supply Chains

India and China have initiated bilateral trade talks aimed at addressing a trade imbalance and supply chain issues. The discussions are focused on finding solutions to these trade-related challenges between the two nations. Officials have indicated an openness to engage in dialogue to resolve these matters. The talks come as both countries navigate complex global supply chain dynamics.
